{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "polar_hbond_hydration_prior",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_favorable",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "Dense N/O sites donate and accept hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "moderate_polarity_favorable",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_mid"},
          "weight": 0.32,
          "rationale": "Broadens thin hetero_high coverage (28) with 91 moderately polar solutes that still hydrogen bond with water."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "apolar_cavity_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none"},
          "weight": -0.55,
          "rationale": "Pure hydrocarbons pay cavity-formation cost with no compensating polar solvation."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_free_favorable",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_none"},
          "weight": 0.28,
          "rationale": "Halogenation raises hydrophobic surface and weakens water hydrogen bonding despite added polarizability."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 0.8,
      "prior_scale": 0.55,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.14,
      "ucb_weight": 0.5,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.68,
      "hypothesis": "Hydration ranking tracks polar hydrogen-bonding capacity, not solubility size terms. Adding a hetero_mid tier widens the polar pool beyond 28 items, targeting the low-AUC seeds that stalled. Fails if top scorers are apolar or halogen-rich."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "reversed_size_polar_aromatic_counterprior",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "midlength_reverses_source_penalty",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": 0.42,
          "rationale": "Reverses the low-confidence negative smiles_mid ESOL prior; multifunctional mid-size solutes accumulate favorable polar solvation."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "short_smiles_source_prior_downweighted",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": -0.25,
          "rationale": "Downweights the positive smiles_short source effect; tiny solutes lack hydrogen-bonding surface even if crystal-free."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "polar_substituted_aromatic",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_low", "hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_mid"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Counters the ring-free source role: heteroatom-substituted single aromatics hydrate well via pi and polar interactions."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heavy_halogen_penalty",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Perhalogenated solutes are strongly hydrophobic, giving unfavorable hydration despite high polarizability."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.1,
      "gp_xi": 0.015,
      "confidence": 0.35,
      "hypothesis": "Counter-hypothesis: the ESOL size and ring-free priors (confidence 0.22-0.41) mislead hydration, so reverse them and favor mid-size polar aromatics. Fails if hydration truly favors small acyclic solutes as the source table suggested."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polar_hbond_hydration_prior",
  "lesson": "Across sixteen development seeds the polarity-first prior led both generations (77.6 and 69.2 mean AUC) while source ESOL size/ring priors stayed near random (51.8, 50.4), so hydrogen-bonding capacity remains the better prior; its weak seeds plateaued, suggesting too-narrow polar coverage rather than a wrong mechanism.",
  "revision_summary": "Kept the winning polarity skill but replaced the weak smiles_mid rule with a hetero_mid tier so 119 rather than 28 candidates receive positive polar mass, and relaxed semantic_mass_end slightly to 0.14 to preserve the prior's early advantage. Replaced the twice-failing source-order skill with reversed_size_polar_aromatic_counterprior, which explicitly reverses the smiles_short/smiles_mid source value priors and the ring-free source role, adds a polar-aromatic interaction, and penalizes heavy halogenation. All rules use catalog-exact field/value pairs; the polarity-first skill is deployed."
}
